Class TotemLayerManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.TotemLayerManager
public class TotemLayerManager extends Object
Owns the totem markers layered over the board: their image views, current tile destinations and the animated movement between snapshots.

Decoupled from phase semantics — the caller decides, via the totemsOnTiles flag, whether totems should sit on occupied tiles or return to the order-tile slots.

      Parameters:
      totemLayer - the pane that hosts the totem markers
      tilesetBox - the board's tile strip (totem destinations during turns)
      orderTileView - the order tile image (totem home when not on a tile)
      animator - animation owner used to move totems
      nodes - shared node factory for totem image views
